agentChannelsPanel.title: Channels
agentChannelsPanel.description: Chat and email identities connected to this agent.
agentChannelsPanel.emptyConnectAgent: Connect an agent identity from Connectors.

legacyBoardSendNotice.title: Discard saved delivery record?
legacyBoardSendNotice.description: First check Activity. Discarding this browser record does not cancel an update that was already accepted. It lets you start a new update.

tasks.empty: This agent hasn't worked on any tasks yet.
tasks.noMatchCapped: No tasks match these filters among the {{limit}} most recently updated.
tasks.showingCapped: Showing the {{limit}} most recently updated tasks.

artifacts.empty: This agent hasn't produced any artifacts yet.
artifacts.showingTruncated: Showing this agent's {{n}} most recent artifacts.

awaitingConsent.title: Waiting for file consent
awaitingConsent.body: The recipient must accept the file card in Microsoft Teams. The file is not delivered yet; this send identity is kept while Paperclip waits.

published.title: Sent to channel
published.body: The board update was published to the connected conversation.

pending.title: Queued for channel
pending.body: Delivery is still pending. Your draft is kept until Paperclip confirms publication.

streaming.title: Publishing to channel
streaming.body: Delivery is still in progress. Your draft is kept until Paperclip confirms publication.

retry.title: Delivery retry scheduled
retry.body: Paperclip will retry this publication. Your draft and retry identity are kept.

deliveryUnknown.title: Delivery not confirmed
deliveryUnknown.body: The provider may have accepted this update. Resolve it in Activity before trying again to avoid a duplicate.

failed.title: Channel delivery failed
failed.body: Your draft is kept. Open Activity to retry this same publication safely.

cancelled.title: Channel delivery cancelled
cancelled.body: Your draft is kept. Some parts may already have been published; check Activity before starting a new send.

storage.unknownSender: An earlier update has an unknown sender. Open Activity to check its delivery before starting a new update.
storage.unreadable: Saved delivery identity could not be read. Check Activity and restore browser storage before starting another send.
storage.rejectionNotSaved: The rejected send could not be saved. Restore browser storage, then retry this same request to recover its receipt.
storage.recordNotDiscarded: Saved delivery record could not be discarded. Restore browser storage, then try again.
storage.rejectionNotCleared: Saved rejection could not be cleared. Restore browser storage before editing this send.
storage.identityNotCleared: Saved delivery identity could not be cleared. Restore browser storage before starting another send.
storage.notPreserved: Browser storage could not preserve this delivery identity. No update was sent. Restore browser storage, then reload to try again.

banner.accountChanged: Your account changed. Reopen this task to send from your current account.

rejected.title: Update was not sent
rejected.toastBody: A selected file already belongs to another comment. Edit the rejected send to correct the selection.
rejected.body: A selected file already belongs to another comment. This request was rejected before any channel message was queued. Your exact draft is kept.

unconfirmedToast.title: Couldn't confirm channel delivery
unconfirmedToast.body: {{detail}} Your draft is kept; retrying here reuses the same request identity.

banner.uploadError: {{detail}} No channel message was sent. Check task files before retrying the upload.

mixed.title: Delivery settled with mixed outcomes
mixed.body: Not every part was confirmed delivered. Review the outcomes below; dismissing this receipt does not resend anything.

remainingConsent.title: Waiting for remaining file consent
remainingConsent.body: Some parts have settled. The remaining file cards still need the recipient's response; this send stays locked until the whole batch is resolved.

banner.slackMirrored: Messages you send here and agent replies are also posted to Slack.
banner.assignmentFixed: Agent assignment is fixed for this external task.
banner.placeholder: Write only what should be visible in the provider conversation.
banner.addMessage: Add a message to send with your files.
banner.filesStay: Files stay on this task until you send them to the channel.
banner.selectionNotice: A file already attached to another comment was removed from this selection. Attach a new copy or share the task link; your message is unchanged.

filesHint.github: GitHub Apps cannot upload file bytes in comments. Checked files stay on the Paperclip task; GitHub receives an authenticated task link when this Board has a public URL, or a private-task notice otherwise.
filesHint.teams: In personal Teams chats, recipients accept each file before upload. Channels and group chats receive supported images directly; other files stay on the task, with a task link or private-task notice.
filesHint.locked: These are the files selected for this send. Selection is locked until delivery is resolved.
filesHint.default: Only checked files will be published to the external conversation.

resend.stalledBody: Your exact draft and request identity are kept. Automatic resends stopped; choose Resend now to try again without creating a duplicate.
resend.waitingBody: Your exact draft and request identity are kept. It resends on its own without creating a duplicate.
resend.unconfirmedBody: Your exact draft and request identity are kept. Retry safely to learn the authoritative publication state without creating a duplicate.

banner.statusRefreshFailed: Delivery status could not be refreshed. Your draft is kept; Paperclip will check again without sending another update.

footer.slack: Your message is posted to Slack with your name and starts the agent.
